question: ORJN is related to ILDH in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, MPHL is related to GJBF. To which of the given options is TWOS related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'ORJN is related to ILDH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73e70bc359b76c0f0d8cc716a65ecbdae6727717c8767f20f8e244e734d3bd91.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7f9df3cd79ec8c4249ebad1ee38bfa4a517e152e1816271eb3ffe51d4564e1c.png] 

For, 'MPHL is related to GJBF'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20c432efcaa3945a0da77af010237a94e0048958bf38837aa0a410886118385b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea70db0ef84aa680d3a4df41ceedc72841422a34e83f560592802b8d573265b2.png] 

Similarly, for '**TWOS**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40b31f8d9276bb2ca27cfd93cb0f44df4dc9837ee72acef73feb7cc382d351a3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7de5acf80bc72bf8459997d88272238fd8841404439ae8f5b7fb43669f6ffb78.png] 

So, '**TWOS**' will be related to '**NQIM**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
